Also known as '''Occidental Mindoro's lone district''', it has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1952.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=17 May 2020}} It first elected a representative provincewide [[at-large]] for the [[2nd Congress of the Philippines|2nd Congress]] of the [[Third Philippine Republic]] following the dissolution of the old [[Mindoro (province)|Mindoro]] province under Republic Act No. 505 on June 13, 1950.{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=505|title=An Act to Create the Provinces of Oriental Mindoro and Occidental Mindoro|url=http://lawyerly.ph/laws/view/l3112 |date=June 13, 1950 |publisher=Lawyerly |accessdate=17 May 2020}} It has remained a [[single-member district]] even under the [[Fourth Philippine Republic]] parliament known as the [[Regular Batasang Pambansa]] from 1984 to 1986. The district is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Leody Tarriela|Leody "Odie" Tarriela]] of the [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas]] (PFP).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=17 May 2020}}{{cite news|url=https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1858438/5-from-pdp-laban-among-32-turncoats-to-marcos-party|title=5 from PDP-Laban among 32 turncoats to Marcos party|publisher=Philippine Daily Inquirer|date=November 12, 2023|accessdate=November 13, 2023}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history |- !Start!!End |- | colspan="9" style="text-align:center;" | ===Occidental Mindoro's at-large district for the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]]=== |- | colspan="9" style="text-align:center;" | District created June 13, 1950 from [[Mindoro's at-large congressional district|Mindoro's at-large district]]. |- | style="text-align:center;" | '''1''' | style="color:inherit;background:{{party color|Nacionalista Party}};" | | | Jesús V.
